warnings.why: The reported male tobacco use rate of 10.1 percent for Paraguay is implausibly low given regional smoking prevalence trends in the Southern Cone.
A male tobacco use rate of 7.8 percent is significantly lower than national and regional public health surveys for Panama.
The reported rate of 5.8 percent for Nigeria is likely an underestimation or based on partial data that excludes various forms of smokeless or local tobacco use.

policy: model memory is advisory; unsupported suspicions cannot overrule official data
